subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported opt-out for model-facing inbound file text, and should that policy live in Feishu config or the shared media/file extraction configuration?
rationale: The requested key is not a current config contract, while the underlying behavior crosses Feishu media download and shared media-understanding extraction, so automation should not invent a new config surface without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add shared file-extraction policy
options.body: Add a documented shared inbound attachment/file-content opt-out that Feishu and other channels can reuse without creating one-off channel semantics.

options.title: Add Feishu-specific config
options.body: Support a Feishu-local `ignoreFileContent`-style option with schema, docs, and tests, accepting the extra channel-specific config surface.

options.title: Document unsupported key
options.body: Keep current media behavior and update docs or diagnostics to tell users that `ignoreFileContent` is not supported and which existing media controls are available.

recommendation.title: Add shared file-extraction policy
recommendation.body: Add a documented shared inbound attachment/file-content opt-out that Feishu and other channels can reuse without creating one-off channel semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is Feishu-facing and package metadata names this handle as the plugin's community contact.
